news.headline: Sensex -1,045 pts to 71,593, Nifty ends 22,232 (18-month low) after RBI hike
news.what_happened: RBI raised repo rate 25 bps to 5.5% (first hike in ~4 years). Brent topped $104, FII selling continued, VIX jumped ~10%. Selling was broad; IT was the main exception.
news.why_it_matters: Rate hike is a headwind for banks, NBFCs and real estate; Nifty sits at multi-month lows so oversold bounce and further weakness are both possible.

news.headline: Nasdaq -1.25%, S&P 500 -0.47% overnight; US 10Y at 5.23%
news.what_happened: US equities fell, tech led the decline; 10Y yield eased slightly from 5.28% but stays very high.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off cue for India, weak Nasdaq is a negative for IT valuations; high US yields keep FII outflow pressure on.

news.headline: Gold +0.9% to $4,196, Silver +1.6%; crude eases ~0.6-0.75%
news.what_happened: Gold and silver rose on safe-haven demand; WTI $90.9, Brent $103.5, both slightly lower.
news.why_it_matters: Gold-loan NBFCs gain from higher collateral values; mild crude easing is a small relief for input-cost sensitive sectors but oil remains elevated.

news.headline: Hang Seng +1.0%, Nikkei -0.8%
news.what_happened: China-linked Hong Kong rebounded while Japan slipped.
news.why_it_matters: Mixed Asia cues; no strong directional signal for Indian metals.

sector_outlook.reason: RBI hike, 10Y yields high, FII selling

picks.catalyst: Gold +0.94% and silver +1.6% overnight on safe-haven demand
picks.logic: Gold loan book collateral value rises with gold; stock fell ~3.6% yesterday with the market, leaving room for a modest mean-reversion if gold holds.

picks.logic: Defensive large-cap with low FII beta; slightly lower crude eases packaging cost. Expect relative outperformance rather than a large move.
